title: On Medial Quandle and Detecting Causality: the tangle lemma for medial quandles (Lemma 4.5)
author: Hongxu Chen
work: On Medial Quandle and Detecting Causality
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the article's Lemma 4.5 (source0.tex lines 376-381, printed as Lemma 4.5 on page 9 of the published version): for a tangle T_A given by a sub-diagram of A_1, any colouring of T_A by a medial quandle forces the two pairs of arcs to carry equal colours, n=d and m=e. The retained complete proof (lines 383-425) is a genuine 43-line combinatorial argument, not a routine verification: the tangle is replaced by an equivalent diagram under the third Reidemeister moves, decomposed into two smaller tangles, the arc labels of the decomposition are computed by iterated crossing relations into explicit compositions of the maps f_xy, the resulting system is solved using the theorem that the group generated by the f_xy is abelian with automorphic elements, and the conjugation identities f_pq o f_qp = id together with the commutation item of the paper's algebraic proposition reduce the two compositions to the identity. The residual difficulty is the passage from a diagrammatic colouring problem to an algebraic system of composed quandle maps and back; this is research-level knot-theoretic algebra well beyond ordinary PhD qualifying exercises.
